info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Investment Management E Trading Workbench-spec
info.description: The Investment Management E-Trading Workbench API enables financial institutions to efficiently manage and oversee investment portfolios through an integrated trading environment. Users can initiate and streamline investment activities while accessing advanced trading tools and analytics. This API is designed for investment managers and traders aiming to enhance their trading strategies and operational efficiencies. Typical use cases include portfolio analysis, trade execution, and real-time market monitoring, making it essential for those in the finance and investment sectors.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new E-Trading Workbench for investment management. It accepts the necessary parameters for configuration and setup, enabling seamless integration into the investment workflow.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary data for executing e-trading operations within the investment management system. The data provided must comply with the defined schema to ensure successful processing.
